title: Mildred and Benny Goodman; the Camel show and the Crosby band
summary: Goodman respected Mildred and used her on his Camel show; she did less well with the Dixieland beat of Crosby's band.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader
